mission.title: My Mission
mission.content: With over nine years of experience in technology, I work as a Senior Programmer and Technical Leader at Adalink, where I lead the development of advanced solutions in Artificial Intelligence and automation. My mission is to transform complex ideas into intelligent and scalable systems.

expertise.title: Technical Expertise
expertise.content: I work with a modern stack that includes Next.js, TypeScript, Python, Node.js and Go, exploring the best of each language to build robust and high-performance applications.

leadership.title: Leadership & Innovation
leadership.content: At Adalink, I lead initiatives for intelligent automations and agent orchestration. I actively participate in architecture decisions and guide the team in implementing solid practices such as clean code, testing and CI/CD.

vision.title: Vision & Values
vision.content: I am an enthusiast of Artificial Intelligence applied to business, with experience in integrations with LLMs such as OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini. My approach combines technique and purpose, always seeking to understand the context of the problem.
